# `^BZ` – POSTAL Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Print a POSTAL barcode (Postnet, Planet, or USPS Intelligent Mail) for automated mail handling.

Reference parameters: **o, h, f, g, t**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 150](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
